description: fts-architecture-ports-used.md's own port table gives the identical port number (8094, and its TLS counterpart 18094) for two differently-NAMED ports - an HTTP REST port and the gRPC scatter-gather transport port. Either the table has a real error (one of the two should be a different number), or Couchbase genuinely multiplexes both protocols on one port and the table's naming implies two separate ports where there is only one - the page does not state which.
